svg.title: How CVE-2026-104850 sends an MCP client's OAuth credentials to an authorization server the MCP server picks
svg.desc: Flow of the MCP TypeScript SDK OAuth bug. Step 1: the client connects to an MCP server over HTTP. Step 2: the server answers 401 and points to protected resource metadata. Step 3: that metadata names an authorization server the server chose. Step 4: the client discovers that server's token endpoint. On @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30.1, or 1.31.0 without expectedIssuer, the client posts its client_id and client_secret to that token endpoint. On 1.31.0 with expectedIssuer, the client throws before sending anything. Results are from a local test on October 13, 2026.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif

g.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: 1. MCP client connects to an MCP server over HTTP with an authProvider
2. Server replies 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="..."
3. Protected resource metadata lists authorization_servers chosen by the MCP server
4. Client discovers that server's token endpoint and builds the client_credentials request

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Red: the secret left the client. Green: the client refused an authorization server it was not bound to.
